snippet.title: 30 + 15 = 45 🔥 Riddle #13 Answer + Riddle #14: How Old Is Person 2? 🎂 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's mystery: two ropes, each burns in exactly one hour but unevenly, and one lighter. Measure exactly 45 minutes.

ANSWER: Light rope A at BOTH ends and rope B at ONE end, at the same time. The two flames on rope A meet after exactly 30 minutes, however unevenly it burns. At that moment, light the other end of rope B: its last 30 minutes of burning now takes only 15. 30 + 15 = 45 minutes!

RIDDLE #14: When Person 1 was 6 years old, Person 2 was half as old. Today, Person 1 is 70. How old is Person 2 now?

Is it 1) 35, 2) 67 or 3) 73? Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.

#riddle #puzzle #brainteaser #logic #mystery #solvebysunrise #shorts
